summary: Veraxa Biotech AG filed a Form 6-K reporting three items: a notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on July 24, 2026, with a record date of July 20, 2026; a press release on cell line development for its BiTAC-TCE platform; and a press release on its partnering strategy and development timelines. The filing does not describe any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. It is a routine current report on corporate updates under Nasdaq rules.
